title: MODIS: Multi-Omics Data Integration for Small and unpaired datasets
abstract: arXiv:2503.18856v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: An important objective in computational biology is the efficient integration of multi-omics data. The task of integration comes with challenges: multi-omics data are most often unpaired (requiring diagonal integration), partially labeled with information about biological conditions, and in some situations such as rare diseases, only very small datasets are available. We present MODIS, a semi supervised framework designed to account for these particular challenges. To address the challenge of very small datasets, we propose to exploit the information contained in larger multi-omics databases by training our model on a large reference database and a small target dataset simultaneously, effectively turning the challenge into a problem of learning with class imbalance. translated_title: MODIS：面向小样本与非配对数据集的多组学数据整合方法
translated_abstract: 计算生物学中的一个重要目标是高效整合多组学数据。这一整合任务面临诸多挑战：多组学数据通常是非配对的（需要对角整合），部分带有生物学条件标签，并且在某些情况下（如罕见疾病），只能获得非常小的数据集。我们提出了MODIS，一个半监督框架，旨在应对这些特殊挑战。为了解决极小数据集的问题，我们建议利用大型多组学数据库中的信息，通过同时在大型参考数据库和小型目标数据集上训练模型，有效地将挑战转化为类别不平衡的学习问题。MODIS对非配对样本执行对角整合，利用类别标签在类别不平衡和数据稀缺的情况下对齐模态。该架构结合了m（注：原文截断，可能为“多模态”相关描述）。
tldr: 提出MODIS半监督框架，通过结合大型参考数据库与小型目标数据集的联合训练，实现非配对多组学数据的对角整合，有效解决小样本和类别不平衡问题。
en_tdlr: MODIS is a semi-supervised framework that integrates unpaired multi-omics data by jointly training on large reference databases and small target datasets, addressing data scarcity and class imbalance via diagonal integration.
